round: council round 3, Security: the Windows walk and the ruling on the lead amendment
rule: A mutant counts as caught only when its suite reaches the baseline check count and at least one check fails; a bash mutant also passes bash -n. Each mutant runs in its own copy of the files the suites read; targetFailed says whether the check the mutant was written for, found by its label, is among the failures.
baselineNote: Baselines are the runs at d52c078 and at the test commit after it; the PowerShell and bash suites ran side by side.
loadNote: The two store mutants ran together, then the PowerShell mutant, then the bash mutant, on one machine shared with other work; seconds are wall times under that load.
